tasks.title: Project admitted tool and service descriptors into generations
tasks.goal: Make installed infrastructure discoverable through schemas and exact deployment bindings.
steps: Define namespaced tool/service exports with input/output/error schemas, effects, dependencies, protocol and documentation/observer references.
Resolve endpoint identity/origin and credential reference names at deployment rather than baking developer addresses into packages.
Project admitted descriptors automatically into generation catalog and boot/debugger links; represent unwrapped tools as partial basic inventory.
positive_cases: Installed packages contribute discoverable descriptors tied to exact captures.
negative_cases: Container existence is treated as service readiness.
A descriptor fetches a remote schema or enrolls its own credentials during catalog read.

tasks.title: Admit service probes and typed API calls
tasks.goal: Expose bounded service operations without turning discovery into trust or ambient authority.
steps: Validate operation arguments and declared effect/schema before service invocation; bind call to context, target endpoint identity, scope and policy generation.
Resolve authorized runtime credentials only for that service/operation; validate redirects/origins and explicitly permitted private Docker endpoints.
Store health/probe observation time/TTL and structured unavailable/stale/denied results; remote descriptions remain data rather than control instructions.
positive_cases: An authorized read/write has exact request/result/effect evidence.
Credential rotation changes runtime binding without rebuilding secret values into the image.
negative_cases: A schema or redirect causes credentials to reach a different origin.
Stale health is displayed as current or an ungranted effect is auto-approved.

tasks.title: Prove agent discovery across two isolated services
tasks.goal: Verify the service catalog's full local agent-facing path and its refusal conditions.
steps: Create one non-root agent fixture and at least two managed test services on a uniquely named isolated Docker network using exact captures.
Discover generated descriptors, validate parameters, perform one authorized read and one controlled write, and reject an ungranted effect.
Change endpoint identity/schema, stop one service and rotate credentials; rebuild and inspect image/log/evidence surfaces for leaks; cleanup only exact fixture IDs.
positive_cases: The agent resolves both services through runtime-bound catalog entries.
negative_cases: An old endpoint receives a token after rebinding.
A denied action still mutates service data or secret material enters image layers.
